title: Fisher-R1: Training LLM Agents for Reliable Hypothesis Testing
abstract: arXiv:2608.07437v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reliable hypothesis testing is the foundation of many empirical scientific claims. Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used to automate this process, as they can inspect datasets, generate code, and produce analyses end-to-end. However, we show that they frequently make subtle inferential errors that lead to incorrect conclusions despite correctly executed analyses. Existing benchmarks fail to capture this failure mode, as they rarely assess whether a reported p-value is statistically valid given the assumptions underlying the data. We address this gap by building P-Bench, a benchmark comprising 425 open-ended, realistic hypothesis-testing tasks spanning economics, biology, and medicine. Each task requires an agent to select a statistical method, compute a p-value, and draw a conclusion given only a scientific hypothesis and a dataset. translated_title: Fisher-R1：训练大语言模型智能体实现可靠的假设检验
translated_abstract: 可靠的假设检验是许多实证科学结论的基础。大语言模型（LLM）智能体正被越来越多地用于自动化这一过程，因为它们能够端到端地检查数据集、生成代码并产出分析结果。然而，我们的研究表明，即使分析过程执行正确，这些智能体仍经常犯下细微的推断错误，从而得出错误的结论。现有基准测试未能捕捉这一失败模式，因为它们很少评估所报告的p值在数据所隐含的假设条件下是否具有统计有效性。为填补这一空白，我们构建了P-Bench，这是一个包含425个开放式、贴近现实的假设检验任务的基准，涵盖经济学、生物学和医学领域。每个任务要求智能体在仅给定一个科学假设和一个数据集的情况下，选择合适的统计方法、计算p值并得出结论。我们进一步提出了Fisher-R1，一个为严格假设检验而训练的开源权重LLM智能体。
tldr: 该论文构建了包含425个开放式假设检验任务的P-Bench基准，并据此训练出能执行严格统计推断、避免细微推断错误的开源权重LLM智能体Fisher-R1。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces P-Bench, a benchmark of 425 open-ended hypothesis-testing tasks, and trains Fisher-R1, an open-weight LLM agent designed for rigorous statistical inference to address the subtle inferential errors made by LLM agents in hypothesis testing.
